# pinned commit fail (scripts/nextflow_accept.sh). Each is investigated in docs/known-issues.md

# the evidence pattern (an ERE searched in the console and the Nextflow log) still match; such a
# preview is reported "known-<outcome>", never "accepted". A row whose pipeline now passes fails
# the gate as stale. Columns are TAB-separated:
